stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(i):
    bg=Counter(x for row in i for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(i,bg)
    objs=[set(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    anchors=[oc for oc in objs if any(r==0 or c==0 or r==len(i)-1 or c==len(i[0])-1 for r,c in oc)][0]
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    ac=Counter(i[a][b] for a,b in anchors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    placed=set()
    for a,b in anchors:
        out[a][b]=ac; placed.add((a,b))
    def paint(a,b,col): out[a][b]=col
    hcol={frozenset(o):Counter(i[a][b] for a,b in o).most_common(1)[0][0] for o in objs}
    markers=[tuple(cc[0]) for cc in cs if len(cc)==1]
    rem=[list(o) for o in objs if o is not frozenset(anchors)]
    rem.sort(key=lambda o_:min(abs(a-p)+abs(b-q) for a,b in o_ for p,q in placed))
    for o_ in rem:
        mowner=None
        mb=near_mark=[m for m in markers if any(abs(m[0]-a)+abs(m[1]-b)==1 for a,b in o_)]
        if mb: m=mb[0]
        else: continue
        best=None
        for dy in range(-H,H+1):
            for dx in range(-W,W+1):
                cl=[(a+dy,b+dx) for a,b in sorted(o_)]
                if any(not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) for a,b in cl): continue
                if any(p in placed for p in set(cl)): continue
                # marker image must be orthogonally adjacent to some placed cell, on the side facing toward cluster
                adj=False
                for p in set(cl):
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(p[0]+da,p[1]+db)
                        if q in placed: adj=True
                if not adj: continue
                key=(abs(dy)+abs(dx),dy,dx)
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,cl)
        if best is None:
            print('FAIL slide',sorted(o_)[:3]); continue
        for a,b in best[1]: paint(a,b,hcol[o_])
        placed|=set(best[1])
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i,o=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    got=solve(i)
    bgv=Counter(x for row in o for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(k,'MATCH' if got==o else 'MISMATCH')
    if got!=o:
        for r in got: print(''.join(str(x) if x!=bgv else '.' for x in r))

Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(I):
    bg=max(set(x for r in I for x in r)-{0}, key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in I)) if False else None
    # memory said: mirror j->W-1-j of non-background cells; background = most common value
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[[bg]*(2*W) for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j,x in enumerate(I[i]):

# Write clean simulator carefully.
def simulate(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg,ci=comps(I)
    objs=[(c,frozenset(cl)) for c,cl in ci]
    # absorption: singleton comps merge into nearest multi (chebyshev dist) recolored to that color
    objs2=[(c,frozenset(cl)) for c,cl in ci]
    absorbed=True
    while absorbed:
        absorbed=False
        new=[]
        for i,(c,cs) in enumerate(objs2):
            if len(cs)>1:
                new.append((c,frozenset(cs)))
                continue
            best=None
            for j,(c2,cs2) in enumerate(objs2):
                d=min(max(abs(y-y2),abs(x-x2)) for y,x in cs for y2,x2 in cs2)
                if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,j,c2,cs2)
            if best and best[0]<=1:
                d,j,c2,cs2=best
                new.append((c2,cs2|cs)); absorbed=True; continue
            new.append((c,frozenset(cs)))
        objs2=new
    objs=objs2
    # move down-left simultaneously until stuck
    for step in range(500):
        occ=occ()
        mv=[i for i,(c,cs) in enumerate(objs)
             if all(0<=y+1<H and 0<=x-1<W for y,x in cs) and not((({(y+1,x-1) for y,x in cs})-(cs)) & occ)]
        if not mv: break
        objs=[(c,frozenset({(y+1,x-1) for y,x in cs}) if i in mv else cs) for i,(c,cs) in enumerate(objs)]
    g=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c,cs in objs:
        for y,x in cs: g[y][x]=c
    rs=[y for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if g[y][x]!=bg]
    xs=[x for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if g[y][x]!=bg]
    crop=[[g[y][x] for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)] for y in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
    return crop
